jelly.prompt: Game sprite sheet of the referenced pet companion (Jelly) redrawn as a tiny cute chibi pixel-art sprite (cute rounded proportions), in the style of premium modern pixel-art idle RPGs like TBH Task Bar Hero. Side view facing right. Crisp hand-placed pixels, dark 1-pixel outlines, limited palette, keep the same colours and features as the reference. Plain flat solid magenta #FF00FF background everywhere. Row 4: hurt recoil (2 frames) then fainting with dizzy stars (4 frames). Same pet design in every frame. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows on background.
